La zona está llena por la temporada y se ven obligados a compartir el lugar, en principio por una noche. Pero una serie de circunstancias hacen que la situación se alargue. La magia navideña hace de las suyas y, poco a poco, entre ISABEL y JUAN ANDRÉS surge una atracción muy especial.

programme.title: Una Navidad Para Recordar
programme.desc: Sebastián detesta la navidad. Y esta le será particularmente difícil, puesto que es la primera que pasa sin sus hijos, después de un duro divorcio. Decide alejarse de la ciudad y pasar la temporada en la casa en que nació, visitando a su madre Ángela, que padece alzheimer. En esa breve y nostálgica temporada, SEBASTIÁN reencuentra la fe en la vida, se reconcilia con la familia, consigue un nuevo camino para el amor y recupera la emoción de la Navidad.

programme.title: Escandalos - La Hora De La Verdad
programme.desc: Un exitoso locutor de radio, que lleva un exitoso programa de denuncias, tiene un romance con una compañera de trabajo. Cuando regresan de un encuentro furtivo atropellan a un adolescente causando su muerte. Todo se complica cuando el caso llega al programa de radio del locutor.

programme.title: Prueba de Fe

programme.title: Mi Amor en Navidad

programme.title: Novios Por Navidad
programme.desc: VALERIA siempre soñó con una boda navideña. Y cuando se hizo planificadora de eventos, eso se convirtió en su sello. programme.title: Escandalos - El Corte Perfecto
programme.desc: Una joven peluquera, harta de los maltratos físicos y sicológicos que recibe de su marido, en un acto de rabia le corta el miembro masculino. El hombre es atendido a tiempo y su virilidad restaurada, pero cuando un grupo feminista intenta convertir a la mujer en su símbolo, se desata una guerra de juicios y acusaciones entre la pareja.

programme.title: Una Navidad Para Recordar
programme.desc: Sebastián detesta la navidad. Y esta le será particularmente difícil, puesto que es la primera que pasa sin sus hijos, después de un duro divorcio. Decide alejarse de la ciudad y pasar la temporada en la casa en que nació, visitando a su madre Ángela, que padece alzheimer. En esa breve y nostálgica temporada, SEBASTIÁN reencuentra la fe en la vida, se reconcilia con la familia, consigue un nuevo camino para el amor y recupera la emoción de la Navidad.

programme.title: La Mejor Navidad
programme.desc: Desde su divorcio, la ambiciosa Gloria ha dedicado todo su tiempo y su atención a su trabajo en Miami. Incluso sus hijos han pasado a un segundo plano. Cuando las circunstancias la obligan a pasar una navidad en familia en el rancho de su exmarido Eduardo en un pequeño pueblo de Jalisco, descubre que la felicidad y el amor suelen esconderse en las cosas más simples.

programme.title: Un Papa Para Navidad
programme.desc: Rebeca es una estrella de las redes. Se ha dejado encandilar de tal manera por la fama y el reconocimiento que su familia ha pasado a segundo plano. Pero una navidad un desconocido se presenta en su puerta afirmando que es su padre. Y aquel encuentro ayudará a Rebeca a recuperar lo verdaderamente importante en la vida.

programme.title: Escandalos - El Lado Oscuro
programme.desc: A un candidato a Gobernador del Partido Conservador , le aparecen unas fotos con una famosa Vedette durante su campaña , su esposa y el denuncian un montaje , el dia que gana las elecciones su esposa descubre que si era cierto el amorío y lo deja en la proclamación de su triunfo de Gobernador

programme.title: Escandalos - Las Apariencias Enganan
programme.desc: Una conocida modelo es arrestada, cuando entregaba dos maletas cargadas de drogas a los sobrecargos de una línea aérea. La investigación revela que una agencia de modelos utilizaba a sus chicas para distribuir drogas a escala internacional

programme.title: Escandalos - La Hora De La Verdad
programme.desc: Un exitoso locutor de radio, que lleva un exitoso programa de denuncias, tiene un romance con una compañera de trabajo. Cuando regresan de un encuentro furtivo atropellan a un adolescente causando su muerte. Todo se complica cuando el caso llega al programa de radio del locutor.

programme.title: Prueba de Fe
programme.desc: A un Sacerdote de alto rango se le encomienda detener una manifestación pacífica, que supuestamente se disfraza de religiosa. Cuando acude al pueblo a investigar se encuentra en presencia de un verdadero milagro

programme.title: Prueba de Fe
programme.desc: Una joven sordomuda quiere ser religiosa. Su familia se opone radicalmente a la idea. Cuando su madre está al borde de la muerte a causa de un accidente automovilístico, la fe de la joven en la Madre Teresa de Calcuta cambia la percepción de la vida en todos ellos.

programme.title: Prueba de Fe
programme.desc: Dos investigadores modernos hacen un trabajo de grado sobre un antiguo milagro de San Martín de Porres. Indagar en las declaraciones de los personajes y conocer directamente a uno de ellos hará que su cruda opinión al respecto se tambalee.

programme.title: Prueba de Fe
programme.desc: Un religioso salesiano es agredido en un barrio por una joven ladrona. En lugar de perseguirla y encerrarla él se decide a seguir los pasos de Don Bosco y redimirla. El encuentro de estos dos personajes dará lugar a un sorprendente milagro.

programme.title: Un Papa Para Navidad
programme.desc: Rebeca es una estrella de las redes. Se ha dejado encandilar de tal manera por la fama y el reconocimiento que su familia ha pasado a segundo plano. programme.title: El Sabor de la Navidad
programme.desc: Una pequeña empresa familiar de Rompope enfrenta una encrucijada cuando una transnacional decide cerrar sus puertas en plena temporada navideña. Gregorio, un ambicioso ejecutivo, es el encargado de supervisar el cierre de la empresa local. Pero, al llegar, es recibido con calidez y hospitalidad por los trabajadores de la empresa, especialmente por Erica, la directora de la planta, que cree que su intención es aumentar la producción. Poco a poco Gregorio se sumerge en la magia de la comunidad, comenzando a cuestionar sus propias lealtades y enamorándose del lugar y de Erica. Gregorio terminará enfrentando a su empresa para salvar a la embotelladora y a sus trabajadores y así ganarse el corazón de Erica.

programme.title: Una Deliciosa Navidad
programme.desc: Máximo y Luciana son amantes de la cocina. Pero hasta allí llegan sus coincidencias. Él es un prestigioso chef apasionado por la comida molecular, y ella es una cocinera intuitiva empeñada en rescatar los sabores de su tierra. Cuando el destino los junta, en plena Navidad, en el restaurante que Máximo hereda de su padre y que Luciana regenta, la combinación es explosiva. Pero también deliciosa.

programme.title: Intercambio Navideno
programme.desc: MAYA y ANA MARÍA son gemelas. Pero fueron separadas al nacer y entregadas a diferentes familias. Fueron criadas de maneras opuestas. ANA MARÍA es ahora una exitosa empresaria divorciada, que solo piensa en su éxito y en el trabajo. MAYA una incansable filántropa, criada por una familia que se dedica a trabajar en pro de los más necesitados. Ya adultas se descubren una a la otra y deciden guardar el secreto, para no hacer daño a sus familias. Pero una navidad deciden hacer la travesura de intercambiar sus vidas por una noche. Sin sospechar que aquella decisión las cambiará para siempre.

programme.title: Una Navidad Complicada
programme.desc: En medio de la temporada navideña, Leticia y Guillermo, divorciados desde hace años, enfrentan una situación inesperada cuando su hijo adolescente recurre a una trampa para reunirlos, falsificando un correo electrónico conde invita a Guillermo y su nueva novia a la casa familiar para Navidad. A medida que la forzada convivencia avanza, la relación entre Guillermo y su exesposa va cambiando. Guillermo descubre cuanto extraña su antigua vida, su vida familiar estable y hermosa. Y descubre que sigue amando a Leticia. Pero, para regresar definitivamente, necesita ganarse el perdón de Leticia y demostrarle que está dispuesto a cambiar. No es tan fácil, pero tal vez el espíritu navideño ayude a que suceda el milagro.

programme.title: Juntos Esta Navidad
programme.desc: Tras una ruptura amorosa, ISABEL decide alquilar una pequeña casita navideña en un apartado pueblito, para pasar la temporada decembrina trabajando en su libro. Pero el viudo JUAN ANDRÉS y su hija LAURITA han tenido la misma idea. Por un error les alquilan la misma casa. La zona está llena por la temporada y se ven obligados a compartir el lugar, en principio por una noche. Pero una serie de circunstancias hacen que la situación se alargue. La magia navideña hace de las suyas y, poco a poco, entre ISABEL y JUAN ANDRÉS surge una atracción muy especial.

programme.desc: A single father and his three daughters are struggling to gain acceptance in their hostile community.

programme.title: Many Pieces of Something
programme.desc: In the middle of the sexual jungle of a music festival in Spain, a group of youngsters try to achieve their dreams.

programme.title: Hollywood Dreams
programme.desc: In the City of Angels, a young Iowan girl (Frederick) fresh off the bus falls in love with a promising actor (Kirk).

programme.title: Love Pyar Whatever
programme.desc: Boy meets girl. Bollywood style! A college student from India comes to the US with more than just studying on his mind. He hopes to find the American girl of his dreams. But that's not easy when you've got meddling relatives and an American cousin looking to get laid. Love and lust get tangled up in this story about meeting The One.

programme.title: Clean Up
programme.desc: After losing her son, Jungjoo loses all hope in life, drinking and smoking her life away. She tries to overcome the pain by attending church and praying diligently to no avail. Then one day, she meets Mingoo, a convicted criminal, wearing dirty clothes that have not seen a washer in who knows how long.

programme.title: The Age of Blood
programme.desc: After a lost battle, Kim Ho, a once-proud swordsman for the king, is suddenly reappointed as a lowly prison guard. Working overnight on his first day, he runs headlong into an attempted prison break.

programme.title: Side-B
programme.desc: Wang Li-Sheng has met a Spanish girl on the Internet and has decided to leave everything behind and live his love story in Spain. Things don ’t work out the way he expected and he eventually ends up with no girlfriend, no money and no passport, so he has to get by as an illegal immigrant in a country he knows nothing about. His luck will change when he meets Marisa, a warm-blood dreamer who has found her place in this country; and Mioara, a girl from Bucharest who arrived two years ago looking for a job. As it usually happens when we are young and things happen too fast, their hearts will lead these tree strangers through not-too straight ways.

programme.title: Off the Grid
programme.desc: An emotionally haunted FBI agent retires and forms a two-person vigilant squad with his old partner in order to take down a child trafficking kingpin.

programme.title: Our Body
programme.desc: An over-educated, disenchanted woman, Ja Young, loses her ambition after many grueling years of studying for the public official exam. One lonely evening, a beautiful, fit runner, Hyun Joo, glides smoothly past her.

programme.title: Our Love Story
programme.desc: A fine arts student meets an attractive bartender, and the two women begin an intimate relationship.

programme.title: Adam and Evelyn
programme.desc: Summer 1989, East Germany. Adam works as a tailor, Evelyn as a waitress. They are planning a vacation together when Evelyn finds out that Adam is cheating on her and decides to leave for the holiday on her own.

programme.title: Miracle in the Valley
programme.desc: Thirteen-year-old Melinda is determined to find out what happened to her real Daddy, and no one in Boonville will help her.

programme.title: Estanislao
programme.desc: A deceitful and unemployed 40-year-old man returns to the house of his mother, who has recently passed away, to spend time with his alcoholic father and with a strange monster that oozes skin pieces, employed as fabric on the family's tailor shop business.

programme.title: Resentment
programme.desc: At the age of 30, Galina is looking for love, but meets a good soldier only for war.

programme.title: Insane
programme.desc: A woman gets kidnapped in the middle of the day and is tortured in a psychiatric hospital. A Journalist gets on the trace of the case and tries to find out the truth.

programme.title: Irene in Time
programme.desc: A film about the complex relationships between fathers and daughters, and the potential lifelong consequences of those relationships.

programme.title: Drown the Clown
programme.desc: A newly hired night watchwoman's deceased child's clown doll goes missing from her place of work and starts appearing in places it shouldn't weakening her already fragile sanity.

programme.title: A Dream Called Death
programme.desc: An introvert and Schizophrenic young man finds the "Perfect Cure" to his mental illness in the form of a damsel whom he considers to be the "Woman of his dream," but his dream somewhat turns out to be a nightmare for him and everyone around him!

programme.title: Lemonade
programme.desc: Mara, a young Romanian woman, has just moved to the US with Dragos, her 9-year-old son, marrying Daniel, an American she has met only a few months ago. The film follows her through a series of revealing encounters during one day, from her problems of babysitting, her unplanned and uncomfortable meeting with a U.S. immigration official, to dealing with the police about her son she had to leave in a motel room and the bank issue for a loan with her husband.

programme.title: When The Smoke Clears
programme.desc: When Kiran Met Karen (WKMK) is a cross-cultured romance set in New York. Chriselle Almeida plays Kiran Lohar, a famous Bollywood actress, who has come to New York to promote her new film ?A Himalayan Love Story?, and spend time with her fianc? Dev Ghosh, a rich and successful musician. At the press conference, Kiran meets a lesbian journalist Karen Sorens. There is an instant connection, attraction. What happens in next few days is the crux of the story. Will Kiran come out of the closet, or will she fear Bollywood ? the industry that gave her the stardom

programme.title: Maggie
programme.desc: A couple's hospital tryst is caught on X-Ray. Thinking she and her boyfriend are the ones in the compromising radiograph, nurse Yoon-young goes in the next day to resign only to find that everyone has called in sick except the head doctor.

programme.title: Teen Idol Tom
programme.desc: Actress Fiona Torrant is one of the elite orphans selected by the exclusive and powerful Font, the nations only academy for the arts, where stars are regularly groomed for enormous fame.

programme.title: 180 Degree Rule
programme.desc: A school teacher from Tehran is preparing to attend a wedding in northern Iran. When her husband suddenly forbids her to go, she makes a choice that will place her on a painful path zig to atonement.

programme.title: Love and a Tragedy
programme.desc: A Mother's devious ploy to ensure her only son marries the right woman seems like the most perfect plan in the world until it boomerangs and lead to a series of unprecedented events.

programme.title: Sweet Face
programme.desc: Tobi and Nkem are deeply in love, and very tight knit.. They struggle with the difficulty in conceiving a child. Nkem eventually gets pregnant and 5 months into the pregnancy they are told by their doctor that their unborn baby has a congenital disorder (down syndrome). They are distraught by this bad news and are torn between keeping their baby or getting rid of it. The decision could drastically affect their marriage and reshape the rest of their lives.

programme.title: Erased
programme.desc: Ana gives birth at the local hospital and everything goes well. There is only a small problem with the paperwork - her file is not on the computer. A temporary loss of data seems to be caused by a software glitch, nothing to worry about. Within a few days, Ana is entangled in a web of bureaucracy of Kafkaesque proportions: not being in the computer means no social security, no permanent address and no baby.

programme.title: The Church Office
programme.desc: Faith, Friendship, and Forgiveness.

programme.title: The Chosen Ones
programme.desc: A modernized retelling of the life of Jesus Christ. This modern day Savior sets out on a mission to confront the wrongs of this world with what is right and to erase the lies with the truth. All in the effort to spread love and understanding. Very quickly this Savior realizes he will need help. He brings together twelve delinquents and embark upon the journey of a lifetime. This journey is complicated by the fact that our Savior, at times, is much more human than superhuman.

programme.title: Whatever It Takes
programme.desc: Based on a true story. Two beautiful Russian women endure terrible hardships in their native land, and come to the United States in search of opportunity and hope.

programme.title: Consequences
programme.desc: Reformed internet scammers who reinvent their old business; this time only targeting immoral people.

programme.title: The Circuit
programme.desc: A Bloomberg Originals series hosted by Emily Chang that goes behind the scenes with founders, influencers and innovators.

programme.title: RAZOR: Shocking the System: Why China is Winning the EV Race
programme.desc: China now produces two out of every three electric vehicles sold worldwide. How did this transformation of the global auto industry happen so fast, and what does it mean for once-dominant European carmakers? Is it an unfair advantage or simply smart strategising? Jen Copestake presents Shocking the System: Why China is winning the EV race—a documentary that takes you inside China's EV revolution. We explore the supply chain dominance that's slashed production costs, and the 'Corner Overtaking' strategy that has helped Chinese automakers leapfrog their global competitors.

programme.title: Walk Again: A New Hope for Paralysis Recovery
programme.desc:
A groundbreaking medical technology in China is offering new hope to people with paralysis.
In Hangzhou, doctors and engineers at Second Affiliated Hospital of Zhejiang University School of Medicine have developed a closed-loop spinal cord neural interface that helps reconnect signals between the brain and muscles, allowing patients with spinal cord injuries to stand and walk again.
This episode follows patients and doctors through a pioneering surgery and the long road to recovery — exploring whether technology can help the human body walk again.

programme.title: Two Sessions Focus: Expanding China’s High-level Opening-up
programme.desc: China’s commitment of advancing high-level opening-up has been reiterated repeatedly at this year’s two sessions. 2026 marks the first year of China’s 15th Five-Year Plan for Economic and Social Development. By prioritizing high-level opening-up, China would boost its attractiveness to foreign investment and trade. CGTN host Lily Lyu talks to Colin Dai, Regional Director of Asia of Glasgow Prestwick Airport of the UK and Prof. Engr. Zamir Ahmed Awan, Founding Chairman of Global Silk Route Research Alliance to get their perspectives on China’s high-level opening-up in 2026 and the years ahead.

programme.title: China Agenda 2026
programme.desc: Special coverage of China's annual sessions of its top legislature and political advisory body, known as the "Two Sessions".

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: How to build a digital twin of a city？
programme.desc: As cities expand and grow more intricate, a new kind of specialist is emerging behind the scenes: the urban digital twin engineer. In the coastal city of Qingdao, these experts are using real-time data and AI to build virtual replicas of the city—helping predict risks, improve infrastructure, and protect the public. CGTN's Liu Jiaxin takes us inside this fast-growing field.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: From trash to treasure
programme.desc: Jiao Jianwei is a senior engineer at the Longgang Energy Eco-Park inShenzhen. Every day, the facility processes 5,000 tonnes of waste, burning it togenerate electricity that powers millions of homes. The leftover ash is alsoturned into eco-bricks, used to pave city roads. From landfills to incineration,China has transformed its waste industry with advanced technologies. Today,the country operates more than 1,000 waste-to-energy plants – nearly half theworld's total. With national goals like "carbon neutrality" and "zero-wastecities" taking shape, engineers like Jiao are turning trash into treasure.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: Who runs China's sea-roving protein factory?
programme.desc: Ever seen "fishermen" farming salmon on a vessel with a displacement bigger than some aircraft carriers? On China's Suhai-1 – the world's first deep-sea salmon and trout aquaculture vessel – these cold-water, high-latitude fish are now thriving far from their natural habitat.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: China's Drone Show Flight Planners
programme.desc: From the skies above Chongqing, thousands of drones light up the night in dazzling displays. Behind the spectacle, a new generation of artists and engineers is redefining entertainment – and showcasing China's growing technological and economic ambitions. In this story, we take a look at the work of a drone show flight planner.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: Standing with sea giants
programme.desc: Along China's eastern shoreline, a new generation of energy workers is redefining what it meansto go to work. For offshore wind engineers, the office is the open sea. In this episode of ourspecial series Jobs 2.0, CGTN reporter Wang Tianyu takes us aboard to follow an engineer livingand working above the waves.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: Who's teaching the robots to work?
programme.desc: As robots gradually move from research labs into real-world tasks, a key question emerges: how do machines learn to handle complex, delicate work? At a Beijing robotics company, engineers are hand-training robotic hands, translating human experience into digital skills that can be replicated at scale. CGTN's Yang Xinmeng explores this emerging profession, speaking with the people who teach machines to cook, care, and manipulate objects with precision. Their work offers a rare glimpse into the intersection of human ingenuity and artificial intelligence – and into the ways humans and robots may collaborate in everyday life.

programme.title: China Agenda 2026
programme.desc: Special coverage of China's annual sessions of its top legislature and political advisory body, known as the "Two Sessions".

programme.title: China's concert boom: Why Gen Z is filling the stadiums
programme.desc:
From packed stadium shows to sold-out performances in smaller cities, China's live music scene is expanding rapidly. Young audiences are turning concerts into a cultural routine: traveling across cities, sharing the experience online and building collective memories around live performances.
The boom now extends far beyond the stage, boosting tourism, retail spending and local economies. In this episode of Unboxing China, we explore how concerts are reshaping consumption patterns and becoming a new driver of cultural and urban development.

programme.title: The self-care economy explained: How emotional spending is reshaping consumer trends
programme.desc:
For months, Chinese social feeds have been filled with "Lao Ji"- a third-person way of saying "me." What began as a slang sign-off, "Love you, Lao Ji. See you tomorrow," now signals a broader shift toward self-care and emotional self-support. It also feeds a huge market where young consumers are rechanneling budgets toward small, meaningful purchases that support emotional wellbeing.
In this episode of Unboxing China, we trace how a casual phrase turned into a cultural movement, reshaping consumption and mental-health talk.

How did this transformation of the global auto industry happen so fast, and what does it mean for once-dominant European carmakers? Is it an unfair advantage or simply smart strategising? Jen Copestake presents Shocking the System: Why China is winning the EV race—a documentary that takes you inside China's EV revolution. We explore the supply chain dominance that's slashed production costs, and the 'Corner Overtaking' strategy that has helped Chinese automakers leapfrog their global competitors.

programme.title: Walk Again: A New Hope for Paralysis Recovery
programme.desc:
A groundbreaking medical technology in China is offering new hope to people with paralysis.
In Hangzhou, doctors and engineers at Second Affiliated Hospital of Zhejiang University School of Medicine have developed a closed-loop spinal cord neural interface that helps reconnect signals between the brain and muscles, allowing patients with spinal cord injuries to stand and walk again.
This episode follows patients and doctors through a pioneering surgery and the long road to recovery — exploring whether technology can help the human body walk again.

programme.title: Two Sessions Focus: Expanding China’s High-level Opening-up
programme.desc: China’s commitment of advancing high-level opening-up has been reiterated repeatedly at this year’s two sessions. 2026 marks the first year of China’s 15th Five-Year Plan for Economic and Social Development. By prioritizing high-level opening-up, China would boost its attractiveness to foreign investment and trade. CGTN host Lily Lyu talks to Colin Dai, Regional Director of Asia of Glasgow Prestwick Airport of the UK and Prof. Engr. Zamir Ahmed Awan, Founding Chairman of Global Silk Route Research Alliance to get their perspectives on China’s high-level opening-up in 2026 and the years ahead.

programme.title: China Agenda 2026
programme.desc: Special coverage of China's annual sessions of its top legislature and political advisory body, known as the "Two Sessions".

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: How to build a digital twin of a city？
programme.desc: As cities expand and grow more intricate, a new kind of specialist is emerging behind the scenes: the urban digital twin engineer. In the coastal city of Qingdao, these experts are using real-time data and AI to build virtual replicas of the city—helping predict risks, improve infrastructure, and protect the public. CGTN's Liu Jiaxin takes us inside this fast-growing field.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: From trash to treasure
programme.desc: Jiao Jianwei is a senior engineer at the Longgang Energy Eco-Park inShenzhen. Every day, the facility processes 5,000 tonnes of waste, burning it togenerate electricity that powers millions of homes. The leftover ash is alsoturned into eco-bricks, used to pave city roads. From landfills to incineration,China has transformed its waste industry with advanced technologies. Today,the country operates more than 1,000 waste-to-energy plants – nearly half theworld's total. With national goals like "carbon neutrality" and "zero-wastecities" taking shape, engineers like Jiao are turning trash into treasure.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: Who runs China's sea-roving protein factory?
programme.desc: Ever seen "fishermen" farming salmon on a vessel with a displacement bigger than some aircraft carriers? On China's Suhai-1 – the world's first deep-sea salmon and trout aquaculture vessel – these cold-water, high-latitude fish are now thriving far from their natural habitat.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: China's Drone Show Flight Planners
programme.desc: From the skies above Chongqing, thousands of drones light up the night in dazzling displays. Behind the spectacle, a new generation of artists and engineers is redefining entertainment – and showcasing China's growing technological and economic ambitions. In this story, we take a look at the work of a drone show flight planner.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: Standing with sea giants
programme.desc: Along China's eastern shoreline, a new generation of energy workers is redefining what it meansto go to work. For offshore wind engineers, the office is the open sea. In this episode of ourspecial series Jobs 2.0, CGTN reporter Wang Tianyu takes us aboard to follow an engineer livingand working above the waves.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: Who's teaching the robots to work?
programme.desc: As robots gradually move from research labs into real-world tasks, a key question emerges: how do machines learn to handle complex, delicate work? At a Beijing robotics company, engineers are hand-training robotic hands, translating human experience into digital skills that can be replicated at scale. CGTN's Yang Xinmeng explores this emerging profession, speaking with the people who teach machines to cook, care, and manipulate objects with precision. Their work offers a rare glimpse into the intersection of human ingenuity and artificial intelligence – and into the ways humans and robots may collaborate in everyday life.

programme.title: China Agenda 2026
programme.desc: Special coverage of China's annual sessions of its top legislature and political advisory body, known as the "Two Sessions".

programme.title: China's concert boom: Why Gen Z is filling the stadiums
programme.desc:
From packed stadium shows to sold-out performances in smaller cities, China's live music scene is expanding rapidly. Young audiences are turning concerts into a cultural routine: traveling across cities, sharing the experience online and building collective memories around live performances.
The boom now extends far beyond the stage, boosting tourism, retail spending and local economies. In this episode of Unboxing China, we explore how concerts are reshaping consumption patterns and becoming a new driver of cultural and urban development.

programme.title: The self-care economy explained: How emotional spending is reshaping consumer trends
programme.desc:
For months, Chinese social feeds have been filled with "Lao Ji"- a third-person way of saying "me." What began as a slang sign-off, "Love you, Lao Ji. See you tomorrow," now signals a broader shift toward self-care and emotional self-support. It also feeds a huge market where young consumers are rechanneling budgets toward small, meaningful purchases that support emotional wellbeing.
In this episode of Unboxing China, we trace how a casual phrase turned into a cultural movement, reshaping consumption and mental-health talk.

programme.title: Around China: Explore Lijiang's vibrant nighttime economy with Naxi culture
programme.desc: In recent years, Lijiang, Yunnan Province, has been leveraging its unique local resources to enrich and elevate its nighttime economy. By promoting activities such as nighttime dining, scenic views, and evening performances, Lijiang has unleashed vibrant consumer energy, attracting a growing number of tourists. Join CGTN Reporter Zhu Zhu to immerse in the Naxi ethnic wear, taking part in a bonfire party at Sifang Street, and explore Lijiang’s nighttime economy firsthand!

programme.title: China's 2025 economic report card: What the data tells us
programme.desc: China's gross domestic product (GDP) grew 5% year-on-year in 2025, official data from the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) showed on Monday. Join CGTN's Lincoln and Vivienne in conversation with leading economists Zerlina Zeng and John Gong as they break down the figures — consumption, investment, jobs, real estate, and trade performance. As global uncertainty lingers, we'll explore how China's economy is evolving — and what the numbers reveal about policy direction and growth prospects in 2026. Don't miss out! #2025inReview #SpendingSmart #InvestChina

programme.title: Two Sessions focus: Unlocking new opportunities under revised Foreign Trade Law
programme.desc:
China's annual meetings of its top legislature and top political advisory body – the Two Sessions – are in focus. In 2026, what signals are being sent on growth, trade and opening-up?
In this episode of BizTalk, CGTN’s Zheng Junfeng speaks with two members of China’s top political advisory body — the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC): Vivian Jiang, chair of Deloitte China, and Lu Ming, executive dean of the China Development Research Institute at Shanghai Jiao Tong University. They unpack how this year’s policy signals are reshaping China’s economic trajectory — and what the revised Foreign Trade Law means for global businesses.

programme.title: China’s Kungfu theme park: A wild ride back in time
programme.desc: At Wansuishan Martial Arts City in central China’s Kaifeng, Henan Province, you’re not just a visitor - you’re part of the story. Every segment in the park is part of an immersive experience rooted in Chinese martial arts and traditional culture. From live matchmaking shows to iron flower performances, from Song Dynasty streets to interactive stages, this uniquely Chinese theme park – with not even one roller coaster or scary ride – was able to record over 24 million visits in 2025.

programme.title: How China's ocean kingdom makes billions
programme.desc: In Southern China, a theme park you've likely never heard of is attracting more annual visitors than Hollywood Universal. The question is, how? Meet Chimelong Ocean Kingdom. It holds seven Guinness World Records and features the largest aquarium on earth. CGTN's Yu Hongyu dives into the strategy behind the splash to see how a local park created a hundred-billion-dollar opportunity.

programme.title: Goa Gajah, Indonesia
programme.desc: Goa Gajah, a 9th-century site in Bali, features Hindu and Buddhist carvings, stone faces, and statues of seven holy rivers. It was rediscovered in 1923.

programme.title: Haghpat Monastery, Armenia
programme.desc: Nestled in Armenia's Lori Region, Haghpat Monastery is a stunning medieval complex that began construction in the 10th century and reflects centuries of architectural evolution.

programme.title: Nish Fortress & Bali-Beg Mosque, Serbia
programme.desc: Like many other cities that have a history going back hundreds of years, the southern Serbian city of Nish has a fortress in its center. The fortres sis also home to three large mosques built by the Turcs. The Bali Beg mosque is a unique monument to Islamic architecture in Serbia.

programme.title: Monastery of Panagia Hozoviotissa
programme.desc: The Monastery of Panagia Hozoviotissa, perched 300 meters above the sea on Amorgos, is a symbol of Greek Orthodox architecture.

programme.title: City of Venice, Italy (Part 1)
programme.desc: Explore Venice, the "floating city," and its architectural treasures along its canals and streets.

programme.title: The Palace Museum (The Forbidden City), China (Part 2)
programme.desc: The Forbidden City, also known as the Palace Museum, is located in the center of Beijing. From 1368 to 1911, it was the Chinese imperial Palace of the Ming and Qing dynasties.

programme.title: Skopje A Blend Of Heritage, North Macedonia
programme.desc: While easily accessible from all points abroad and boasting all the amenities of the Western world, North Macedonia is still one of Europe’s least discovered tourist destinations: a natural paradise of mountains, lakes, and rivers, where life moves to a different rhythm, amidst the sprawling grandeur of rich historical ruins and idyllic villages that have remained practically unchanged for centuries.

programme.title: Hovhannavank, Armenia
programme.desc: Established in 1216 near Hovhannavan village, Hovhannavank Monastery is an important historical site located on the edge of a gorge in Armenia.

programme.title: Ashkelon (National Park), Israel
programme.desc: Ashkelon, on Israel's Mediterranean coast, features Tel Ashkelon and ancient ruins within Canaanite ramparts, alongside dunes and natural landscapes.

programme.title: Apollonia (National Park) Israel
programme.desc: This coastal park has Crusader castle ruins, Mediterranean views, a Roman villa, and the Sidni Ali Mosque, with picnic grounds and sand dunes nearby.

programme.title: Tel Afek (Fort Antipatris), Israel
programme.desc: Antipatris, in Israel's Yarkon National Park, features Tel Afek and over 6,000 years of history by the Yarkon River springs.

programme.title: Sultan Amir Ahmad bathhouse, Iran
programme.desc: Sultan Amir Ahmad Bathhouse, one of the oldest Persian hammams, dazzles with its turquoise and gold design, showcasing unique architecture and historical charm.

programme.title: Perge Antik Kenti, Antalya, Turkey
programme.desc: Perge, an ancient city in Pamphylia, flourished under Rome and features ruins like a theater, stadium, and baths.

programme.title: Plovdiv, The city on seven hills, Bulgaria
programme.desc: Plovdiv, one of Europe's oldest cities, features a hilly landscape rich with historical remnants from various civilizations throughout history.

programme.title: Kaleto Archaeological Complex & Vrachanski Balkan Nature Park, Bulgaria
programme.desc: Mezdra, a picturesque town in Bulgaria's Vratsa Province, offers historical heritage sites like the Kaleto Archaeological Complex and Vrachanski Balkan Nature Park.

programme.title: Vannes Old City, France
programme.desc: Old City Walls of Vannes are fortifications built between the 3rd and 17th centuries to protect Vannes' city. It is located on the Gulf of Morbihan at the mouth of two rivers, the Marle and the Vincin, around 450 km southwest of Paris.

programme.title: Ethno Village-Museum Ljubacke Doline, Bosnia & Herzegovina
programme.desc: Exploring different cultures and experiencing lives utterly different from yours is the best part of discovering new horizons.

programme.title: Corinaldo old town, Italy
programme.desc: Let yourself be captivated by Corinaldo, an old city in the Italian region of Marche.

programme.title: Beit Guvrin, Israel
programme.desc: Beit Guvrin, a National Park in southern Israel, features the ancient city of Tel Maresha and its famous caves.

programme.title: Fly Over Honduras
programme.desc: The Explorers takes you between the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans, over the vastness of Honduras's forests and mangroves, often shrouded in mist.

programme.title: Fly Over Society and Tuamotu in French Polynesia
programme.desc: The Explorers leaves for the enchanting islands of Society and Tuamotu in French Polynesia, in the wake of the great explorers. Crystal-clear atolls and lagoons, ringed by coral reefs

programme.title: Fly Over Society and Tuamotu in French Polynesia
programme.desc: The Explorers leaves for the enchanting islands of Society and Tuamotu in French Polynesia, in the wake of the great explorers. Crystal-clear atolls and lagoons, ringed by coral reefs

programme.title: Fly Over Australes and Gambier
programme.desc: The Explorers introduces you to two of the five archipelagos of French Polynesia in the heart of the Pacific Ocean: Australes and Gambier.

programme.title: Fly Over Honduras

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: We present to you historic image and film documents from the Porsche 550 RS Spyder. And: how the Audi Quattro shocked its competitors with its driving dynamics.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: High-tech turbo cars from the wild 1980s are reunited at the Salzburgring race track. Also: the Lancia Beta Monte Carlo, a small Italian two-seater with mid-engine offers classic car driving pleasure at a low entry price.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: The 1947 Triumph 1800 Roadster provides space for 5 fresh air fans. Also: Le Jog, the toughest classic car rally in Europe. A German women's team takes on the challenge in their VW Iltis. And: a charming oldie, the 1919 Wolseley Stellite.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: With the M3, BMW brought race car technology to the road. In addition: 120 years of Mercedes-Benz motorsports history. And: turbo power in the DTM. The Ford Sierra RS Cosworth taught its racing competition the meaning of fear.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Cars like the Ford GT 40, the Jaguar D-Type or the Mercedes 300 SL wrote history on the race track and now break records at auctions. A sumptuously restored 300 SL will start at the most famous classic car rally in the world, the Mille Miglia.

programme.title: Audi Quattro
programme.desc: Advantage through Technology on rally tracks. The Audi Quattro shocks opponents.

programme.title: Ford GT40
programme.desc: With their V8 cars, Ford showed that they were able to build race winners. The Ford GT40 was a prime example for that, especially in Le Mans.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: We took the Ferrari 458 Italia for a spring ride around Lake Starnberg. Also: a test drive of BMW's 6 series convertible at the Table Mountain in South Africa. And: the Chevrolet Orlando family van.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Audi built only 333 units of its GT model. We tested the everyday use compatibility of the R8 GT. In addition: the Mazda MX5, the most popular roadster in the world. And: the Mercedes-AMG GT3.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: More efficiency, less weight and more sportiness is what Audi promotes in order to win the race against BMW and Mercedes with their A6 2.0 TDI. Also: Patrick Dempsey and his racing team at the Grand Am Rolex Sportscar GT series.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: We put the Wiesmann MF5 at the racetrack in Spa-Francochamps in the Belgian Ardennes to the test. Also: Audi A1 vs. Mini Cooper RS. And: the GT Academy 2011 qualifying rounds.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The Nurburgring 24 Hours is considered the most difficult long distance race in motor sports. Volkswagen set themselves this challenge with a car built especially for this occasion, their Golf 24.

programme.title: Tauric Chersonesos, Crimea
programme.desc: 528 BC. in the west of the Heracles Peninsula, the Dorian Greeks founded the city of Chersonesus in Crimea, which means ""peninsula"".

programme.title: The Palace Museum (The Forbidden City), China (Part 1)
programme.desc: The Forbidden City, also known as the Palace Museum, is located in the center of Beijing.

programme.title: The Palace Museum (The Forbidden City), China (Part 2)
programme.desc: The Forbidden City, also known as the Palace Museum, is located in the center of Beijing.

programme.title: Vannes Old City, France
programme.desc: Old City Walls of Vannes are fortifications built between the 3rd and 17th centuries to protect Vannes' city.

programme.title: Agrasen ki baoli, India
programme.desc: In the heart of New Delhi, India, discover a centuries-old subterranean marvel: Agrasen Ki Baoli.

programme.title: Church of the Holy Sepulchre, Israel
programme.desc: A tour of the Church of the Holy Sepulcher, the heart of the holy city of Jerusalem.

programme.title: Zawayat el-Shadlia, Israel
programme.desc: Discover Zawiyat al-Shaziliyya in Akko. Akko’s strategic location has sparked the lust of the major regional powers for centuries.

programme.title: Preza Castle & the Xhamia Preze Mosque, Albania
programme.desc: Preza is one of the most scenic areas of the valley of Tirana.

programme.title: Saint Demetrius Cathedral, Albania
programme.desc: Berat is one of the most beautiful places to visit in Albania and a a World Heritage site since 2005.

programme.title: Haghpat Monastery, Armenia
programme.desc: Nestled within the lush terrain in the Armenian Lori Region stands the majestic and breath-taking Haghpat Monastery.

programme.title: Yereruk, Armenia
programme.desc: Yereruk, is characterized by the ancient Armenian Church built on a plateau near the mighty Akhurian River.

programme.title: The Dormition of the Mother of God Cathedral in Varna, Bulgaria
programme.desc: The Dormition of the Mother of God Cathedral is the largest cathedral of Varna and one of the most impressive sites in the city.

programme.title: Church of the Visitation, Israel
programme.desc: The Church of the Visitation is a Catholic church in Ein Karem, Jerusalem, and honors the visit paid by the Virgin Mary, the mother of Jesus, to Elizabeth, the mother of John the Baptist.

programme.title: Vinh Trang Pagoda, Vietnam
programme.desc: This is My Tho, the capital city of Tien Giang province in Southern Vietnam famous for its rich history, rich culture and unique cuisine, and is also home to the largest Buddhist pagoda in the province.

programme.title: Catedral Basilica Metropolitana, Colombia
programme.desc: Medellin is a city situated in the northwest of Colombia, 400 km away from the capital Bogota.

programme.title: The Giza Pyramid Complex, Egypt
programme.desc: Around the ancient capital city of Memphis, in Egypt, located just south of modern-day Cairo, are the greatest and strangest structures ever created by humankind, The Egyptian Pyramids.

programme.title: Chateau d'Aguilar, France
programme.desc: In the beautiful commune of Tuchan, situated within the French department of Aude, lies the spectacular Château d’Aguilar.

programme.title: Cathedral La Major, France
programme.desc: Just on the outskirts of the delightfully vibrant Marseille, lies what locals affectionately call the Cathedral of La Major.

programme.title: Church of Our Lady of the Waters, Colombia

programme.title: Ein Kerem, Israel (Part 1)

programme.title: Ethno Village-Museum Ljubacke Doline, Bosnia & Herzegovina

programme.title: Holy Week, Israel (Part 1)

programme.title: Hook Down, Wheels Down
programme.desc: Produced in the early 1970s, "Hook Down, Wheels Down" was one of the most comprehensive (and expensive) films made by the U.S. Navy. It covers the history and development of the U.S. aircraft carrier, and does so through interviews with many of the men who made it happen. While dozens of aircraft carriers are featured, it is the USS John F. Kennedy (CV-67) that takes center stage -- and the material shot on her deck looks like it is right out of "Top Gun". There is wonderful flight op footage, great aerial flight footage, incredible WWII dog fightand bombing footage as well as endless aircraft carrier operational footage. Also shown in this film are very rare images of the first aircraft carrier USS Langley (CV-1) (formerly collier USS Jupiter AC-3). The follow on vessels are widely featured including USS Lexington (CV-3) and the USS Yorktown (CV-5) in the Battle of Coral Sea. Also featured: USS Saratoga (CV-2), USS Enterprise (CV-6), USS Hornet (CV-8), USS Wasp (CV-7), USS Ranger (CV-4), USS Yorktown (CV-5), USS Essex (CV-9), USS Guadalcanal (CVE-60), the British carrier HMS Furious, the destroyer USS Zeilin (DD-313), and many other warships. Various incidents are shown from Pearl Harbor, Midway, Coral Sea, the capture of the submarine U-505, the Marianas Turkey Shoot, the Doolittle Raid on Japan, and more. Includes interviews or appearances by many WWII naval aviators and aces including Wade McClusky, John Jay Courtney, Billy Mitchell, Gerald Bogen, Leslie Generes, John S. Thatch (of "Thatch Weave" fame), Ensign George Gay, David Campbell (whose Minsi III appears in the film), Edward "Butch" O'Hare, Charles Lindbergh, Glenn Curtiss, Clark Gable and Wallace Beery. Planes seen in the film include the Wright Brothers flier, biplanes, Lindbergh's Spirit of St. Louis, the NC-4 Flying Boat, Hellcat, Avenger, Corsair, Vindicator, Devastator, Wildcat, and Japanese Zero. Also seen in the film: dogfights, combat flying, the Washington Conference on battleships, the Panama Canal exercise of 1929, air mail service.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc:
A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels.
A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: The new Mercedes-Benz GLC AMG Line World Premiere Teaser
programme.desc:
The new GLC is immediately recognisable as a member of the Mercedes-Benz SUV family. Standard equipment includes the AVANTGARDE exterior with Chrome package including chrome window surrounds and a new, chrome-look simulated underguard. This adds striking design features and enhances the unique proportions of the vehicle. One of the defining design highlights of the GLC is the redesigned front end, with headlamps that connect directly to the radiator grille to emphasise the vehicle’s width, and the new radiator grille as part of the standard AVANTGARDE exterior, which now has a chrome surround and a sporty louvre in matt grey with chrome trim. The AMG Line has a radiator grille with Mercedes-Benz pattern.
The body design is characterised by a full, spanned surface design enriched with precisely shaped edges in the sides. These emphasise the proportions, accentuate the muscular wheel arches and create a balance between elegance and off-road performance. Wheel arch liners in the vehicle colour are available from the AMG Line upwards for the first time. These accentuate the sportiness of the AMG Line, as optional equipment in conjunction with mixed tyres. Also available as an optional extra are easy-entry running boards and, from the AMG Line upwards, a Night package.

programme.title: The Mercedes EQS SUV Electric Art Line Driving Video
programme.desc:
With the luxury saloon EQS and the sporty executive saloon EQE, Mercedes-Benz has entered a new, all-electric era in the upper market segments as well. The EQS SUV, the third model series with this architecture developed for electric vehicles, will soon follow. The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease.
The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). The interior dimensions benefit from these generous SUV dimensions and from the advantages of the purpose design tailored to the electric platform. The second row of seats can be electrically adjusted as standard. Up to four golf bags fit in the boot. A third row of seats with two additional individual seats and extensive comfort features for all passengers is available as an option.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought - The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc:
The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health.
With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain’s electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title:
To celebrate the arrival of the new Bentayga EWB, an exclusive First Edition is now available. Subject to a limited production run for the first twelve months of orders, it combines many of the most desirable options available for the car with a package of eye-catching details found only on Bentley First Editions.
First Edition badging can be seen to the exterior of the car – a theme that extends inside, with badging on the veneered fascia, as well as embroidery on the seats. Unique First Edition contrast stitching and embroidery adorns the seats and, depending on the choice of veneers, handcrafted metal overlays just 0.075 mm thick can be applied to the fascia and waistrails in the front and the rear door veneer.
The First Edition offers elegant and timeless design, focusing on maximum comfort and well-being. This specifically tailored specification includes a unique 22” ten-spoke directional wheel and bright lower bumper grilles. Other additional features as standard include unique quilted seats, mood lighting, a heated steering wheel, and increased driver’s assistance aids. Attention to detail is clear, from the badging that identifies the car to the jewelled caps on the fuel and oil fillers.

programme.desc: The new model line’s assistance systems perfect ease of driving and safety. Included as standard in the ID. Buzz and ID. programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc:
The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland.
The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below.
The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover’s Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK.
Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover’s luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter’ desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven’s Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc:
The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt.
The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light - Digital Future Lighting
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi’s “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc:
A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels.
A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

The one-make championship, organized by MINI Italia with the support of ACI Sport, is ready to kick off the eleventh season. This year there are three categories that compete on the tracks of the main Italian circuits, in six exciting events from 2 July to 23 October 2022.
San Donato Milanese. Now in its eleventh consecutive edition, the MINI Challenge 2022 single-make championship warms up its engines to start a season full of challenges. Also this year, MINI Italia renews its commitment to organizing one of the most exciting competitions on the Italian scene. Passion, challenge, community and the art of performance are among the values of the famous championship signed by the iconic premium brand with a sporting DNA.
The six events of 2022 will see the drivers compete on the tracks of the most famous national circuits. The MINI John Cooper Works Challenge Lite, the MINI John Cooper Works Challenge Pro and the MINI John Cooper Works Challenge Evo are ready to challenge each other in a new season full of emotions. The Academy race category continues in 2022, which also sees the under 25s on the track, as part of the MINI program dedicated to young people.

programme.title: The Mercedes EQS SUV Electric Art Line Driving Video
programme.desc:
With the luxury saloon EQS and the sporty executive saloon EQE, Mercedes-Benz has entered a new, all-electric era in the upper market segments as well. The EQS SUV, the third model series with this architecture developed for electric vehicles, will soon follow. The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease.
The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). The interior dimensions benefit from these generous SUV dimensions and from the advantages of the purpose design tailored to the electric platform. The second row of seats can be electrically adjusted as standard. Up to four golf bags fit in the boot. A third row of seats with two additional individual seats and extensive comfort features for all passengers is available as an option.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought - The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc:
The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health.
With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain’s electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E05 - Masters of Attack
programme.desc: Carnivores can't just pick their meals off trees. To survive, they have to use every trick they've got to catch food that's just as keen on staying alive as they are. If their prey hides, they have to find it. If it runs, they must chase it. They have to track it if it's hard to pin down and beat it if it fights back. The predator might use its strength for the final blow, but the real effort lies in the strategy.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E06 - Devious Defenses
programme.desc: Animals can employ a number of different defenses in order to withstand an attack. Whatever the strategy it is clear that animals will do whatever it takes to survive the wild.

programme.desc: Carnivores can't just pick their meals off trees. To survive, they have to use every trick they've got to catch food that's just as keen on staying alive as they are. If their prey hides, they have to find it. If it runs, they must chase it. They have to track it if it's hard to pin down and beat it if it fights back. The predator might use its strength for the final blow, but the real effort lies in the strategy.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E06 - Devious Defenses
programme.desc: Animals can employ a number of different defenses in order to withstand an attack. Some seek safety in herds, some hide in plain sight, some meet aggression with even stronger aggression, and some build fortresses. Whatever the strategy it is clear that animals will do whatever it takes to survive the wild.

programme.title: Jim Shockey's Uncharted - S01:E11 - True North
programme.desc: Arctic Pt2. Inuit Elders provide guidance as Jim and Corey prepare to face the ice once again on a special invite to document a traditional Inuit hunting expedition.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E07 - Hawaii Access Shane Dorian
programme.desc: The number of axis deer in Hawaii has exploded, making them a big problem for this stunning Pacific paradise. In this episode, Mario meets up with Shane Dorian, a big wave surfer, as they head out on an expedition.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E08 - Talking Turkey Frank Stallone
programme.desc: Mario teams up with Frank Stalone and heads to Kansas to find Easton turkeys. With Frank's Italian roots, Mario is sure they can create turkey meatballs that taste incredible.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E09 - Backcountry Ice Man Chuck Liddell
programme.desc: Former UFC lightweight champ, Chuck Liddell, and Mario ride horseback in the mountains of Idaho, venturing into bear territory. They're on the hunt for a mysterious protein source.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E10 - 1000 Tuna Quest
programme.desc: Mario heads to the far eastern edge of Canada to visit Prince Edward Island. It's famous for having some of the largest bluefin tuna in the world, with these fish reaching up to 1000 pounds.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E11 - Royal Children Prince William and Prince Harry
programme.desc: Two young men who have had to cope with extraordinarily challenging events and circumstances as, together, they have gone on to change the face of the British royal family and carve meaningful roles for themselves in the modern world. programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E26 - Prince William A Royal Portrait

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E13 - William And Kate One Year On
programme.desc: William and Catherine got married in a fairytale ceremony on April 29, 2011, with more than two billion people tuning in and celebrations happening all around the world.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E03 - William And Kate A New Royal Family
programme.desc: Here's a look at the first year for a new Royal Family after Prince William and Kate welcome a baby boy.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E07 - William And Kate Into The Future
programme.desc: From a regular student to a royal girlfriend, Kate Middleton has transformed into a real-life princess. In less than ten years, this everyday girl with a normal background captured her prince's heart and is now on track to become the future Queen of England.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E22 - Harry The Mysterious Prince
programme.desc: Despite all the media buzz, much of it not exactly flattering, Harry remains a bit of an enigma. This engaging documentary offers fresh insights and footage to shed light on a royal prince who has dealt with both heartache and scandals.

programme.title: Harry & Meghan: A Very Modern Romance
programme.desc: Meghan Markle and Prince Harry share similar interests and seem like a perfect match. Both have faced tough times growing up but have come out on top. Now they're winning together. This hour-long special, featuring a chat with author Andrew Morton, explores the social backdrop that makes their bold marriage fit right in with today's British Royal Family.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E06 - Princess Diana's Legacy
programme.desc: Reflecting on Diana's legacy, this show delves into what Princess Diana left behind after her sudden passing - the impression she left on her children, the royal family, and the people who loved her. The young princes drew admiration with their demeanor at her funeral, but many questioned how their bond with Prince Charles would be moving forward.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show - S01:E12 - Venice and Northern Ireland
programme.desc: Venice, one of Europe’s most iconic and enchanting cities with its labyrinth of waterways and canals linking one hundred and eighteen separate islands. From Venetians to visitors, it’s the city where everyone oozes style. Then on to Northern Ireland, for a ghostly trail around a haunted hotel and a walk on the road to Winterfel, visiting some of the iconic locations featured HBO’s Games of Thrones series.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show - S01:E13 - Barbados and Lake Como
programme.desc: Barbados has it all. Home to The Cliff, one of the world’s most famous restaurants where sharks swim in the floodlit bay and entertain diners. Considered by many to be the best of the Caribbean Islands it is home to media moguls and pop princesses alike. Italy’s Lake Como also plays host to a number of famous Hollywood stars and directors who’ve fallen in love with its breath-taking vistas and fabulous cuisine.

programme.title: Dropped - S02:E02 - Horses Can Think...Rafts Can't
programme.desc: In episode two, Casey continues where they left off. They're faced with a choice. Once they've settled into a risky spot on the mountain, they see that the ram they were after isn't legal to hunt, so they have to retreat.

programme.title: Dropped - S02:E03 - Band of Ten
programme.desc: The crew reaches a canyon where they find a group of ten rams. After the thrill of the first wave, they quickly become disappointed and frustrated when none of the rams are legally suitable.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E04 - Trapped in a Glacier
programme.desc: While hiking alone deep in Glacier National Park, Ted Porter plummets into an icy glacial crevasse. With a broken back and miles from anyone, he must fight to survive.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E05 - Stranded in the Alaska Wilderness Part 1
programme.desc: Hunters Adrian Knopps and Garrett Hagen venture into the remotest part of Alaska's Misty Fjord, hunting Moose and Bear. After a successful hunt Adrian finds himself trapped by a twenty foot tidal surge after Garrett fails to return with the skiff.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E06 - Stranded in the Alaska Wilderness Part 2
programme.desc: After a successful hunt., Adrian Knopps' hunting partner disappears taking their bear out to the boat. Now Adrian finds himself stranded on a tidal flat surround by bears and wolf packs and with massive storm bearing down on him. How will he survive?

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E07 - The Journal
programme.desc: Pastor Mike Turner is on a solo hike across the continental divide in the unforgiving Wind Rivers Range of Wyoming when he becomes hopelessly trapped under a boulder. He chronicles his grueling 11-day fight to survive in his own journal.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E08 - Tree Stand Fall
programme.desc: Deer hunter Nathan Holcomb plummets from his tree stand. Every hunters' worst nightmare becomes Nathan's reality. With a broken back and paralyzed, Nathan must crawl out on his own to find help.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E04 - Battle Plans
programme.desc: Surviving in the wild often means being able to fight and win. This fighting strategy is called agonism and is used to set ranks, get resources, claim territory, and attract partners. There's no certainty in the wild, but animals that get good at agonism have a better shot at living to see another day.

programme.desc: In episode two, Casey continues where they left off. They're faced with a choice. Once they've settled into a risky spot on the mountain, they see that the ram they were after isn't legal to hunt, so they have to retreat.

programme.title: Dropped - S02:E03 - Band of Ten
programme.desc: The crew reaches a canyon where they find a group of ten rams. After the thrill of the first wave, they quickly become disappointed and frustrated when none of the rams are legally suitable.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E04 - Trapped in a Glacier
programme.desc: While hiking alone deep in Glacier National Park, Ted Porter plummets into an icy glacial crevasse. With a broken back and miles from anyone, he must fight to survive.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E38 - HM The Queen A Remarkable Life
programme.desc: The most notable woman in modern times has to be our Late Queen, Elizabeth II. She ruled for 70 years, the longest reign in British history. Once a princess who wasn't supposed to be queen, Elizabeth II led the country to thrive after World War II and became a steady presence in our changing world. In a thousand years of British monarchy, Elizabeth II is likely one of the most outstanding monarchs ever.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E17 - Remembering Diana Princess Of Wales
programme.desc: Remembering Diana, Princess of Wales includes scenes from her state funeral and heartfelt words from her closest friends. It's a warm and reflective look at Diana both as a person and a public figure: the queen that never was and the princess who'll always be remembered.

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E03 - Predators Prowl
programme.desc: Chris and Kaid were getting their rafts set up, while Casey and R.L. started looking around for black bears and moose. Just then, Chris and Kaid noticed a predator making its way towards their campsite.

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E04 - Cloudy Days
programme.desc: It's the second day of hunting season, and Chris and Kaid are still on the lookout for big game. They head downstream to see if they can find a better spot to catch some fish. Meanwhile, Casey and R.L. feast on salmon, getting some much-needed protein. Huge storm clouds are pouring over Alaska.

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E08 - Operation Rocky Mountain Front
programme.desc: During hunting season, game wardens stay on their toes by catching poachers with an elk decoy, tracking down trespassers, and checking hunting tags.

programme.title: Life on the Edge - S01:E06 - Missing
programme.desc: Charlie Summerville disappears while trying to transport building supplies by boat. Meanwhile, Pat and Connie Harvie have to handle a flood of volcano experts showing up at the most isolated ranch in America.

Learn more about its discovery, significance and why it is now classified as a Grade One National Cultural Relic.
